title: Python Foundations
content: Variables, data types, control flow, functions, comprehensions, and object-oriented programming. Build a fluent foundation in idiomatic Python — the language used across the data stack.
objectives: Write Pythonic code using comprehensions and unpacking
Apply OOP for reusable data tooling

title: NumPy & Pandas
content: Vectorized computation with NumPy, tabular manipulation with Pandas — joins, groupby, reshaping, and time series. The workhorses of every data role.
objectives: Replace Python loops with vectorized operations

title: Data Visualization
content: Matplotlib, Seaborn, and Plotly for analytical and presentation-grade charts. Principles of visual encoding, accessibility, and storytelling.
objectives: Choose the right chart for the question

title: Statistics & Probability
content: Distributions, sampling, hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, and the Central Limit Theorem. The statistical literacy that separates analysts from spreadsheet operators.

title: Machine Learning Fundamentals
content: Supervised vs unsupervised learning, the bias-variance tradeoff, regularization, and the scikit-learn workflow. Train, evaluate, and tune real models.
objectives: Frame business problems as ML problems

title: Model Evaluation
content: Cross-validation, classification metrics, ROC and PR curves, calibration, and pitfalls of accuracy. How to know your model actually works.
objectives: Select metrics aligned to business cost

title: Deep Learning Intro
content: Neural network mechanics, backpropagation, activation functions, and the modern training loop with PyTorch.
objectives: Implement and train a feedforward network

title: LLM Fundamentals
content: Transformer architecture, attention, tokenization, and scaling laws. Build the mental model behind how modern LLMs actually work.
objectives: Reason about context windows and KV caching

title: Prompt Engineering
content: System prompts, few-shot patterns, chain-of-thought, structured outputs, and the empirical art of getting reliable behavior from LLMs.

title: Embeddings & Vector Search
content: Embedding models, similarity metrics, approximate nearest neighbor indexes, and hybrid search. The retrieval substrate behind every RAG system.
objectives: Choose between dot product, cosine, and L2
Build hybrid search with BM25 + vectors

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
content: Chunking strategies, retrieval pipelines, re-ranking, and grounding. Move from demo to production-grade RAG.
objectives: Design chunking strategies for your domain

title: Function Calling & Tool Use
content: JSON schemas, tool definitions, multi-turn tool loops, and parallel calls. Turn an LLM into a reasoning interface to your systems.
objectives: Define tools that the model uses correctly

title: AI Agents
content: Planning, memory, reflection, and multi-step autonomous workflows. ReAct, plan-and-execute, and when not to use agents.

title: Evaluation & Guardrails
content: Golden datasets, regression tests, LLM-as-judge, and runtime guardrails. The discipline that turns prototypes into reliable products.

title: HTML & Semantic Markup
content: Semantic elements, accessibility, ARIA, and the document outline. Build markup that works for screen readers, SEO, and humans.
objectives: Apply ARIA where native semantics fall short

title: Modern CSS
content: Flexbox, Grid, custom properties, container queries, and responsive design. The modern layout toolkit without the cargo-cult.
objectives: Build with custom properties and design tokens
Handle responsive layouts without media-query soup

title: JavaScript Essentials
content: Closures, async/await, ES modules, and the event loop. The mechanics every web developer needs in their fingertips.
objectives: Explain the event loop and microtask queue

title: DOM & Browser APIs
content: Event delegation, fetch, IntersectionObserver, storage APIs, and performance APIs. The browser as a platform.

title: Flask Backend
content: Routing, blueprints, request context, templating with Jinja, and persistence with SQLAlchemy. The backend half of the stack.
objectives: Persist with SQLAlchemy without N+1 queries

title: REST API Design
content: HTTP semantics, status codes, idempotency, versioning, pagination, and error envelopes. Design APIs that survive contact with clients.

title: Authentication & Security
content: Sessions vs tokens, OAuth 2.0, OWASP Top 10, and password storage. Don't roll your own crypto — but know what you're using.

title: Marketing Fundamentals
content: The marketing funnel, AIDA, customer journey mapping, and unit economics. The vocabulary every marketer must own.

title: Search Engine Optimization
content: On-page, off-page, technical SEO, Core Web Vitals, and EEAT. The fundamentals of organic search visibility in 2026.

title: Content Marketing
content: Pillar pages, topic clusters, the skyscraper technique, and content distribution. Content that ranks, converts, and scales.

title: Paid Advertising
content: Google Ads, Meta Ads, attribution, ROAS, and bid strategies. Profitable paid media is engineered, not stumbled into.
objectives: Structure Google Ads accounts that scale

title: Social Media Strategy
content: Platform mechanics, the algorithm game, creator economy, and community building. Beyond posting and hoping.

title: Email Marketing
content: List building, segmentation, deliverability, and lifecycle automations. Still the highest-ROI channel — when done right.

title: Marketing Analytics
content: GA4, UTMs, attribution models, and incrementality testing. Move from clicks-and-impressions to incremental revenue.

title: Product Thinking
content: Jobs-to-be-done, opportunity sizing, and outcome-over-output thinking. The mental models that separate PMs from project managers.

title: User Research
content: Interviews, surveys, usability testing, and synthesis. Generate insight that survives leadership scrutiny.
objectives: Run interviews that uncover real needs

title: Roadmapping & Prioritization
content: RICE, MoSCoW, Kano, now-next-later, and stakeholder alignment. Frameworks that make trade-offs explicit.

title: Requirements & PRDs
content: User stories, acceptance criteria in Given-When-Then, and non-functional requirements. Specs engineers can build from.
objectives: Write user stories with INVEST criteria

title: Product Metrics
content: AARRR, North Star Metric, leading vs lagging indicators, and the trap of vanity metrics.

title: Experimentation
content: A/B test design, MDE, power, multiple testing, and reading results honestly. Where most PM-led tests go wrong — and how not to.

title: Launch & GTM
content: Positioning, beta strategies, launch tiers, and rollout safety. Launches that move the needle, not just the press release.
objectives: Write a positioning statement that focuses execution
Run safe rollouts with feature flags

title: Excel for Analytics
content: Formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and Power Query. The analytics tool that's still on every business user's desktop.
objectives: Build pivot tables for ad-hoc analysis

title: SQL Fundamentals
content: SELECT, JOINs, GROUP BY, subqueries, and the SQL execution order. The lingua franca of data analytics.

title: SQL Advanced
content: Window functions, CTEs, recursive queries, query optimization, and EXPLAIN. Where junior SQL becomes senior SQL.
objectives: Apply window functions to ranking and time-series problems

title: Power BI & Tableau
content: Data modeling, star schemas, DAX measures, and dashboard design. From query results to executive-grade reports.
objectives: Write DAX measures that aggregate correctly

title: Data Storytelling
content: Chart selection, narrative structure, audience adaptation, and the executive summary. Insight is wasted without communication.
objectives: Write executive summaries that get read

title: A/B Testing for Analysts
content: Test design, sample size, SRM detection, segment analysis, and the multiple-testing problem. Defensible experimentation.

title: Business Acumen for Analysts
content: Unit economics, financial statements, KPIs by function, and the language of executives.
objectives: Speak to executives in their language
